lessonRef.subject: ready-for-life
lessonRef.title: Unit performance task: where to get help with a consumer problem

standardsRefs: Manuel Academy local Ready for Life composition
objective: I can complete a realistic where to get help with a consumer problem task, document the result with minimal private data, and revise a step that does not meet the lesson criteria.
scenario: Using a new provided fictional consumer-problem scenario, the learner identifies the specific term at issue, documents it in the same log format from earlier this unit, drafts an escalation message, then researches one real, current local or regional resource that helps with consumer problems, verified rather than assumed.
safetyNotes: The consumer-problem scenario is fictional and provided with this lesson.

The researched help resource must be a real, current, verifiable source (such as a consumer protection office or local extension service); the learner is not asked to actually contact it as part of this lesson.
materials: learner-local: the documentation log format from an earlier lesson

tasks.directions: Analyze the complete worked example on swk-rfl-g10-u04-l06-model-card before beginning.

prompts.text: Name the first move in the model and explain why it comes first.

tasks.directions: Complete the fictional coached case on swk-rfl-g10-u04-l06-guided-card, use criterion-specific feedback, and finish its fresh correction turn.

prompts.text: Name the move you completed and the success check it meets.

tasks.directions: Choose the permitted real-life route or complete fictional route on swk-rfl-g10-u04-l06-independent-card; follow every step and retain only the named minimal evidence.

prompts.text: Which complete route did you use?
Record the completed step numbers and one non-sensitive result statement.

tasks.directions: Complete the minimal evidence record on swk-rfl-g10-u04-l06-evidence-record; omit or fictionalize private details.

prompts.text: Of everything this unit covered, which single skill do you think you're most likely to actually use, and why?

remediation: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g10-u04-l06-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step. Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g10-u04-l06-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check. Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments. Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g10-u04-l06-retry-pair without the coach prompt. Exit: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: End-to-end coherence: The log entry and escalation message are consistent with the identified term. | Resource research quality: Names a plausible real resource with a source. | Unit-level synthesis: Names a specific skill from the unit and a plausible reason it's likely to be used. Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g10-u04-l06-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.
extension: Have the learner write a short guide, in their own words, that a friend could follow for handling a similar consumer problem, covering all four steps from this lesson.

productionDepth.practicalGoal: I can complete a realistic where to get help with a consumer problem task, document the result with minimal private data, and revise a step that does not meet the lesson criteria.

duration.adultTime: No adult time required unless the learner chooses support

resources.title: where to get help with a consumer problem coached first attempt
resources.purpose: Carries the complete first attempt and a fresh correction turn.
content: Fictional practice condition: Using a new provided fictional consumer-problem scenario, the learner identifies the specific term at issue, documents it in the same log format from earlier this unit, drafts an escalation message, then researches one real, current local or regional resource that helps with consumer problems, verified rather than assumed.
Coach direction: Read the new fictional scenario and identify the specific term at issue.
Learner prompt: Name the specific term or rule at issue in this scenario, not just a general description of the problem.
Feedback check: name the move completed, point to the matching success check, and identify one missing or uncertain step without judging the learner.
Fresh correction turn: use the same fictional condition with one constraint changed; restate the changed constraint, redo only the affected step, and check the new result.

resources.title: where to get help with a consumer problem complete application
resources.purpose: Contains the lesson-specific application directions and prompts; it is the delivered card referenced by the learner flow.
content: Application direction: Document the problem using the log format from earlier this unit, then draft the escalation message requesting the specific remedy.
Response 1 (t2-p1): Write your documentation log entry for this problem: what happened, the date, and the relevant term.
Response 2 (t2-p2): Draft your escalation message, citing the term and requesting the specific remedy it supports.
Equal-access rule: Use the fictional condition above and complete the same reasoning and evidence without private real-world details.

resources.title: where to get help with a consumer problem minimal evidence record
resources.purpose: Defines exactly what the learner saves and what must not be collected.
content: Record only: selected route, completed step numbers, one non-sensitive result statement, and one revision if a step changed.
Reflection: Of everything this unit covered, which single skill do you think you're most likely to actually use, and why?

Success checks: End-to-end coherence: The log entry and escalation message are consistent with the identified term. | Resource research quality: Names a plausible real resource with a source. | Unit-level synthesis: Names a specific skill from the unit and a plausible reason it's likely to be used.
Do not collect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations; account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details; photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules.

resources.title: where to get help with a consumer problem supported and parallel retry cards
resources.purpose: Delivers a real correction loop rather than a direction to try again without support.
content: Contrast reteach: compare the model check on swk-rfl-g10-u04-l06-model-card with the missed or unsupported step; name the one observable difference.
Supported card: return to swk-rfl-g10-u04-l06-guided-card, complete the affected move with one coach prompt, and receive criterion-specific feedback.
Parallel card: use a fresh fictional where to get help with a consumer problem condition with one changed constraint; complete the same move without the coach prompt.

Exit check: the corrected move meets this lesson's checks — End-to-end coherence: The log entry and escalation message are consistent with the identified term. | Resource research quality: Names a plausible real resource with a source. | Unit-level synthesis: Names a specific skill from the unit and a plausible reason it's likely to be used..
Return: resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g10-u04-l06-independent-card; a physical route resumes only when the authorized adult says it is safe.

guardianInvolvement.role: Optional coach only; no guardian attestation is required.
guardianInvolvement.signOffBoundary: A guardian attestation certifies only that the named physical event occurred. It never scores the learner reflection or proves effort, honesty, maturity, responsibility, diagnosis, or character.

safety.stopRule: Stop the physical route when permission, supervision, a safe setting, or an expected material is missing, or when a new hazard appears. Continue only when the authorized adult resolves it; otherwise use the complete fictional route.
safety.physicalBoundary: The learner follows the source safety notes and never performs adult-only handling, transport, account, legal, medical, heat, sharp-tool, electrical, chemical, or machine actions.
safety.noShameRule: Describe only the observable step, condition, evidence, or revision. Never label the learner, household, body, ability, effort, maturity, responsibility, or character.

privacy.rule: Collect the smallest process record that shows the lesson steps. A learner may choose fictional details and may decline private disclosure without losing credit.

account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details
photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules

may: coach the guided and retry cards
mayNot: observe or claim a physical condition
tutorBoundary.physicalCompletionRule: Tutor or AI may coach. Tutor or AI may not certify that a real-world physical action occurred.
tutorBoundary.missingResourceAction: Stop and name the unresolved resource. Do not fabricate it; use another complete delivered route only when every resource for that route resolves.
